description.content:
The Western Union Mass Payments API enables financial institutions and enterprise customers to send up to 10,000 international payments in a single batch across 130+ currencies in 200+ countries and territories. The API supports payment lifecycle management including batch creation, adding payments, FX quotes, committing, and tracking. Authentication requires mutual TLS (mTLS) client certificates provided by Western Union upon partnership enrollment.
